completed.description: True if the phase's stated goal was fully achieved. False if any part was skipped, deferred, or blocked.

committed.description: True if a git commit was made as part of this phase.

commit_message.description: The commit message used, or null if no commit was made.

summary.description: One-to-two sentence human-readable description of what changed.

blockers.description: Anything that prevented full completion. Empty if completed cleanly.

notes_for_next_phase.description: Information the next phase should be aware of. Empty if not applicable.
